methodology: ORA applies a structured, multi-factor assessment methodology to evaluate a tenant's rental profile across defined parameters, including identity, residence, occupation, financial capacity, credit behaviour, repayment conduct and rent suitability.

Information obtained from available and permissible sources is evaluated and, where applicable, cross-validated across relevant data points to assess its consistency, reliability and relevance within the context of the proposed tenancy.

The assessment represents a consolidated evaluation of the information available at the time of review. No individual parameter, data point, score or indicator is considered determinative in isolation; the assessment outcome is derived from the collective consideration of relevant factors under the ORA assessment methodology.
